new_tests.purpose: Fixture and current-repository tests for metric catalog schema, required metric fields, missing/skipped semantics, source artifacts, and report-view exclusion.
Fixture and current-repository tests for required coverage layers/surfaces, real evidence cross-checks, and 1000 dry-run boundary.
CI guard that runs the builder, validates both schemas, checks workflow coverage, and forbids P14 or real/fault wrappers in static L03 workflow commands.

new_cli_gates.acceptance: Generates schema-valid metric_catalog.json and coverage_matrix.json, exiting 0 when there are no blocking findings.

new_artifact_checks: Metric catalog includes name, unit, source_artifact, source_sha256, scenario, node_count_scope, evidence_layer, source pointer, and missing semantics for every metric.
Coverage matrix includes fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run layers.
Coverage matrix includes cluster_build, management, workload, observability, fault, failover, stability, cleanup, scale, and report_visualization surfaces.
Real coverage entries point to valkey_e2e_evidence artifacts with real_valkey=true, status PASS, Valkey 9.1.x, and matching nodes_observed.
1000 dry-run planner entries never count as real coverage.
Missing and skipped values preserve MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, or NO_BASELINE_YET plus reason.
Rendered report views are cataloged only as views, not source metric measurements.

expected_initial_failures.reason: L03 metric coverage builder does not exist before implementation.
metric_catalog schema and artifact do not exist before implementation.
coverage_matrix schema and artifact do not exist before implementation.
tests/metrics and tests/coverage do not exist before implementation.
L03 CI metric coverage gate test does not exist before implementation.

acceptance_criteria: Metric catalog schema, coverage matrix schema, builder, tests, CI guard, and generated artifacts exist.
Generated metric_catalog.json and coverage_matrix.json validate against their schemas.
Builder reads machine-readable JSON/JSONL artifacts and loop reports, not rendered report views as source truth.
The catalog covers cluster build, management, workload, observability, fault, failover, stability, cleanup, scale, and report/visualization surfaces.
Coverage matrix has fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run layers.
30/50/100 real coverage entries are backed by committed real Valkey evidence with matching observed nodes.
1000 dry-run coverage is dry-run-only and contributes zero real coverage.
Missing/skipped/no-baseline metrics preserve explicit status and reason.
No historical phase/gate artifact is modified to manufacture coverage.
No P14, real Valkey wrapper, or fault wrapper command is run.
